preheader: Best Buy sales surge, Pentagon eyes automaker drones, and Sinner sidelined by knee surgery.

lead.headline: Best Buy Posts Best Quarterly Sales Growth in Five Years
lead.body: Electronics retailer Best Buy reported third-quarter results that beat Wall Street expectations during CEO Jason Bonfig's first quarter leading the company. Same-store sales grew as holiday shopping began, signaling resilient consumer demand for tech products.
lead.why: Tracking big-box retail earnings ahead of Black Friday gives you real-time sales data to analyze for your Merage business and economics courses.

stories.headline: Pentagon Talks with GM and Ford to Mass-Produce Military Drones
stories.body: The U.S. Department of Defense is holding preliminary talks with General Motors, Ford, and Magna International to supply parts and scale up domestic military drone manufacturing.
stories.why: Seeing legacy automakers move into defense hardware shows how traditional supply chains adapt to new tech contracts.

stories.headline: Micron Upgraded as Memory Chip Prices Rise and Capacity Fills
stories.body: Semiconductor maker Micron received an upgraded strong buy rating as DRAM memory spot prices crossed $60. The company has already sold 75 percent of its capacity for calendar year 2027.
stories.why: Monitoring hardware supply bottlenecks helps you evaluate stock valuations and chip sector trends for personal investing.

stories.headline: Anthropic AI Solves Unsolved Math Problem and Challenges CS Tenets
stories.body: An Anthropic researcher used AI to generate a 17-million-line solution to the Riemann hypothesis. Anthropic and OpenAI also noted that recent breakthroughs disproved a core principle of computer science research.
stories.why: Understanding how to audit complex AI outputs will be essential if you evaluate AI software performance in tech consulting.

stories.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI Employees Warn Unreleased AI Models Are Unsafe
stories.body: Internal debates at Anthropic and OpenAI have intensified as more than two dozen sources report employees fear their unreleased AI models are becoming too powerful to deploy safely.
stories.why: Model safety decisions affect product launch timelines and corporate risk governance, topics key to management studies.

stories.headline: BCG Report Shows 96 Percent of Indian Workers Use AI Regularly
stories.body: A report by Boston Consulting Group revealed that 96 percent of employees in India use AI daily or several times a week, saving an average of 15 hours per week.
stories.why: Seeing where AI productivity tools gain traction globally gives you insight into global consulting operations and workforce shifts.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Researchers Create Physics-Guided AI for Fluid Dynamics
stories.body: Researchers at UC Irvine built a computational framework that combines physical laws with AI to reconstruct fluid motion, such as blood flow through the heart, from incomplete data.

stories.headline: Jannik Sinner Undergoes Knee Surgery and Will Miss Australian Open
stories.body: Five-time Grand Slam champion Jannik Sinner had surgery on his right knee for iliotibial band syndrome and faces a three-month recovery, ruling him out of the 2027 Australian Open.

term.name: Same-Store Sales
term.definition: A retail metric that compares sales revenue from existing store locations open for at least one year. It shows organic growth without counting new store openings.

serve.headline: Verra raised $5M to fix institutional memory for consulting firms
serve.body: Verra raised a $5 million seed round to build tools that capture and organize historical client project data. The startup aims to stop consulting firms from losing internal expertise between engagements.
